method.type: rolling OOS Smart Money component attribution diagnostic
method.component_thresholds: participation/absorption score q75 and raw 20d dollar-volume q75 from each fold TRAIN only
method.liquidity_score_saturation: live liquidity component reaches 100 at >= $75m 20d average dollar volume; raw dollar volume is used for true q75 attribution
method.liquidity_floor_variant: $75m 20d average dollar volume minimum, matching the live-score saturation point
method.quality_selection: existing quality intensity selected on TRAIN only
method.concentration: pre-capacity eligible signal concentration; diagnostic, not exact portfolio attribution
method.warning: current-universe survivorship bias remains; this is development attribution evidence
method.interpretation_guard: a variant retaining most baseline signals is a floor/removal effect, not evidence of a strong ranking factor
